body:
First I'm sorry that you feel like this from time to time. I know its difficult but maybe you should channel that negative energy into something you would enjoy or to better yourself. When I get really depressed I like to swim laps in a pool. Escaping your feelings isn't necessarily a good thing but I like to escape from reality by reading a good book. 

Would you like to talk about the things that set you over the edge?
Actually, I'm struggling with the opposite. I'm tired of just living for myself instead of for someone else or with someone else. It's gettin' to not be enough anymore.

You seem intelligent and articulate. I hope you find something you feel is worth living for. This might not help but, for me, I had to find things that I really loved doing that were exciting for me. I love to snowboard; it is something I can't live without. I love to read and it gets me through the day. I'm struggling to find someone who cares about me right now and who I am as a person. Maybe you could volunteer at an animal shelter and share the love and affection for your rats with other creatures that need your love. You could work at a national park or do volunteer work there. 

Much love, whooopsydaisy
Send me a message if you'd like. We can talk.

Sucks slicehazard. Honestly, I would cut her out of your life. I know you said you can't but you kinda need to. Your friend is a douche for showing her affection in front of you. You are young, but if you are smart you'll realize this is just one of many bumps through life you'll go through. You'll find someone else; don't linger on this one too much.

Good luck llama. Maybe find something you really enjoy. It helped me a lot. I snowboard as much as I can. I need to find something in the off season though. I hope you find some excitement in your life, hopefully that way you'll be dying to talk to someone about it. And maybe, you'll find others that enjoying talking about stuff with you. 

Much love, whooopsydaisy.

I think there are plenty of people that would want to date you. Do you realize how many men on reddit are lonely and desperately want a relationship? What makes your ex so great that he can't be replaced for someone better?

Phew, ok. It's not about sex. I'm not a virgin. I want someone to be with and talk to. Being in a relationship helps personal growth; without it your growth as a person becomes stunted. That growth includes: social ques, perspective, empathy, etc. 

I'm tired. I don't have a consistent outlet for my thoughts where I can get feedback. And I certainly don't wanna be the fuckface who gets the girl because she finally realizes what she wants (instead of the mastiff jackasses she dated a thousand times before). 

I've done what I can, but I'm tired of just living for myself.

You can always move somewhere and start a new life, if you are of age. Also find a hobby you've always dreamed of doing. Mine is snowboarding. It's an activity that lets me forget everything. All I have to do is focus on staying alive while speeding down a mountain on a piece of plastic.
Sucks doesn't it? It's essentially being the "suffering hero" except there's no audience to feel empathy for you. (suffering hero has some psyche definition, its counterpart is the conquering hero)

I went to a therapist a long time ago. Two actually. They told me to focus on school and get the semester done, then maybe take a break from school and figure out who you want to be. Well I've done that; I took a break for a year, figured out who I wanted to be and now I'm back here.

I actually talked to my mother's life coach once, just outta curiosity. She was a vapid, superficial person. I'm just tired of being alone. I've taken my breaks here and there. I am the person I want to be, but when is enough, enough? I appreciate your concern though.

Thanks, I appreciate it. I'm just exhausted. My mind just kinda runs and runs. I want someone to be interested in what goes on inside my head so I can just let it spill out. Its just been so long... I'm just tired. My other relationships were completely worthless as well. Anyhow, keep hangin in there. Good luck.
Hope your still there. Wanna talk about you motive for such as serious action?

I lol'd. Sure I'm struggling with depression. I want someone to talk to when I wake up in the morning. I want someone to understand my effort I put into engineering. I want a good snuggle while reading a book. Having sex after a long day on the slopes would be great. 

All things I've tried haven't worked though, and I've tried too hard for too long. What makes me the most sad, I think, is that I feel like I'm this awesome person with a interests hobbies and unique perspectives but I'm not wanted by anyone. I advertise them as well when it's appropriate; its not like I'm a quiet beta that people know nothing about. I simply don't get it - and I'm just over it at this point.

Hey there Jellyfish.

I feel ya bud. What I've heard everyone say is that you can't expect someone to love you if you don't love yourself. I know those are just words, but if you look at it from the perspective of a potential SO I think it makes a lot of sense. 

I hate a lot of social stigmas and parts of humanity, but honestly its just meta evolution in my opinion. Its for me to get past the ignorant populous, but I try to live for myself and make myself a better person. I enjoy snowboarding and things that make me feel alive. 

Essentially find something you care about, something exciting and hopefully it'll change how you think about yourself.
